articles.summary: Fiscal Year EPS Increases 8% to $3.96 Quarterly EPS Increases 6% to $1.04 from $0.98 for Preceding Quarter Quarterly Return on Average Assets Increases to 1.56% Quarterly Return on Average Equity Increases to 11.72% Quarterly Net Interest Margin Increases to 3.96% Quarterly Cash Dividend Increases 3% HOQUIAM, Wash., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Timberland Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: TSBK) (“Timberland” or “the Company”), the holding company for Timberland Bank (the “Bank”), today reported net income of $31.17 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 7% from $29.16 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025. Earnings per diluted common share (“EPS”) increased 8% to $3.96 for the 2026 fiscal year from $3.67 for the 2025 fiscal year. Timberland also reported net income of $8.11 million, or $1.04 per diluted common share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
